vul_knowledge.solution_behavior: To mitigate the vulnerability, it is necessary to add boundary checks to ensure that the remaining size of the data buffer is sufficient before reading short or long values. If the remaining size is insufficient, the loop should break to avoid reading past the end of the buffer. This ensures that the function safely reads the data without exceeding the bounds of the allocated memory, thus preventing potential security issues.
